# freshdesk_company (Resource)

A company that contacts can belong to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "freshdesk_company" "northwind" {
  name         = "Northwind Traders"
  description  = "Wholesale distribution"
  domains      = ["northwind.example", "northwind-traders.example"]
  health_score = "Happy"
  account_tier = "Premium"
  renewal_date = "2027-03-31"

  custom_fields = {
    # Non-string values are given as JSON.
    seat_count = "250"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the company. Must be unique across the helpdesk.

### Optional

- `account_tier` (String) Account tier. The allowed values are the choices configured on the account's Account Tier field.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values keyed by field name. Non-string values are given as JSON, for example `"42"` or `"true"`.
- `description` (String) Description of the company.
- `domains` (Set of String) Email domains belonging to the company. Contacts with a matching address are associated automatically.
- `health_score` (String) Relationship strength. The allowed values are the choices configured on the account's Health Score field.
- `industry` (String) Industry. The allowed values are the choices configured on the account's Industry field.
- `note` (String) Free-text note about the company.
- `renewal_date` (String) Contract renewal date, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the company was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the company.
- `updated_at` (String) When the company was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_company.example 42
```
